exposure: First trimester biochemical markers (PAPP-A, PlGF, free-b hCG)
Second trimester biochemical markers (PAPP-A, PlGF, hCG, AFP, uE3, Inhibin A)
cohort: The study included pregnant women who had undergone multiple marker aneuploidy screening.
finding: A combination of maternal characteristics with first trimester PAPP-A and PlGF provided reasonable accuracy in identifying women at risk of developing early onset preeclampsia.
